title: Anime Astral Simulator Script - AUTO FARM, AUTO QUEST, AUTO
features:
[+] Auto Farm (keybind F, modo toggle)
[+] Movement: Teleport / Smooth / Stay In Place
[+] Height offset (0-15 studs)
[+] Extra attack delay (0 = cap do servidor)
[+] Return to start on stop
[+] Anti-AFK
[+] Status ao vivo: status, alvo + distância, kills/min, dano por hit, hit radius + Range Lv
[+] Targeting
[+] Priority mode: Closest / Highest Tier / Highest Rarity / Fastest Kill / Highest HP
[+] Allowed tiers: VeryEasy, Easy, Medium, Hard, MiniBoss, Boss
[+] Max distance
[+] Max hits to kill (0 = sem limite)
[+] Retarget interval
[+] Boss Priority
[+] Count MiniBoss as boss
[+] Bosses only
[+] Lista de bosses vivos no mundo atual
[+] Botão: Teleport to strongest boss
[+] Quests
[+] Auto Quest Farm (trava o Auto Farm nos inimigos que a quest precisa)
[+] Travel to quest world
[+] Auto Quest Claim (1 WorldToken por quest)
[+] Status: quest, progresso, o que falta (+ hits-to-kill por inimigo)
[+] Auto accept side quests
[+] Auto claim side quests
[+] Status: ativas / claimadas / não aceitas
[+] Automation

[+] Auto Open Stars + Roll interval (estaciona na EggStation e pausa o farm)
[+] Auto Equip Best Team + Team interval
[+] Auto Loadout + Loadout stat (Power/Yen/Damage/XP/Drop/Luck) + Loadout interval
[+] Auto Click (ataca parado)
[+] Auto Buy Worlds

[+] Gamemodes
[+] Auto Raid + seletor de raid + Auto leave at wave + wave
[+] Auto Gate Raid
[+] Auto Arise Shadows
[+] Auto Equip Best Shadow + interval
[+] Auto Wave Defense + seletor + Auto leave at wave + wave
[+] Auto Trial + seletor (Easy/Medium)
[+] Auto Progress
[+] Auto Equip Best Avatar
[+] Status: raid, gate, arise, defense, trial, progressão, avatar
[+] Economy
[+] Auto Roll Power Systems + Systems to roll (Passive, Grimoire, SwordPassive, PetPassive, Gacha) + Roll interval
[+] Auto Equip Best Roll Systems + tipos (Pets, Sword, Titan, Shadow, Accessory) + interval
[+] Auto Rank Up
[+] Auto Trial Upgrades + Upgrade status
